test_title: PYST 5: SSC CPO - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: A and B together can do a piece of work in 8 days. B and C can do it in 12 days, and C and A can do it in 16 days. In how many days can A alone do the work?
solution:
**Given:**

A + B time = 8 days

B + C time = 12 days

C + A time = 16 days

**Formula Used:**

Work = Rate × Time

Total work = LCM of given times

Rate = Work ÷ Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ LCM of 8, 12, 16 = 48

⇒ Total work = 48 units

⇒ (A + B) rate = 48 ÷ 8 = 6 units/day

⇒ (B + C) rate = 48 ÷ 12 = 4 units/day

⇒ (C + A) rate = 48 ÷ 16 = 3 units/day

⇒ (A + B) + (B + C) + (C + A) = 6 + 4 + 3 = 13 units/day

⇒ 2(A + B + C) = 13

⇒ (A + B + C) = 13 ÷ 2

⇒ A = (A + B + C) − (B + C)

⇒ A = (13 ÷ 2) − 4

⇒ A = (13 − 8) ÷ 2 = 5 ÷ 2 units/day

⇒ Time taken by A = 48 ÷ (5 ÷ 2)

⇒ Time = 48 × (2 ÷ 5)

⇒ Time = 96 ÷ 5

⇒ Time = 19.2 days

**∴ The correct answer is 19.2 days.**
